domain.description: Site Domain — the site identifier/slug (e.g. "sb-xxxx-site"), not a network hostname (required)

type.description:
Connector to configure (stored under site.apps):
- googleAnalytics — GA4 Measurement ID "G-XXXXXXXXXX" (G- + 10 chars), e.g. "G-AB12CD34EF"
- gtm — Google Tag Manager container "GTM-XXXXXXX"
- facebookPixel — numeric Pixel ID
- twitterPixel — lowercase alphanumeric Pixel ID (min 5 chars)
- appsFlyer — dev key UUID (8-4-4-4-12)
- adjust — 12-char alphanumeric app token
- singular — JSON string: { sdkKey, sdkSecret, bundleId }

value.description: Connector ID/token in the exact format required for `type` (e.g. "G-AB12CD34EF" for googleAnalytics). The server validates the format and returns HTTP 400 on mismatch.

domain.description: Site Domain — the site identifier/slug (e.g. "sb-xxxx-site"), not a network hostname (required)

componentCode.description: Main block JSX (required). GLOBALS — DO NOT import, they are injected automatically (importing causes "symbol already declared"): useControls, text, color, toggle, number, select, localizedText, AutoControls. MUST IMPORT explicitly (NOT globals): import { TextEditor } from '@site-builder/block-utils'; — required for every canvas text field; missing this import = ReferenceError at runtime. Component signature: export default function MyBlock() {} — no props, no ({ localizedText }).

settingsCode.description: Settings panel JSX (optional). With Magic Controls: export default () => <AutoControls />;. AutoControls is a global — do NOT import it. Omit only if the block has no editable fields.

name.description: Human-readable block name shown in the editor (optional). If omitted, derived from the component function name.

textFields.description: Canvas-editable text fields. Required for every visible text in the block (headings, body, buttons, CTAs). Each entry creates a localizedText() binding used with <TextEditor id={localizedText("name")} /> in componentCode.

name.description: Stable identifier for the text field (e.g. "title", "cta")

default.description: Default text value for this field

version.description: Block version. REQUIRED — always pass the maxVersion returned by get_block_schema. Using an outdated version creates blocks with the wrong structure.

position.description: Zero-based index where the block should be inserted in the page (optional). Omit or pass undefined to append at the end. E.g. position: 0 inserts at the top, position: 4 makes the block 5th.

blockValues.description: Override default block values (optional). Must be { values: {...}, components?: [...] }. Localized fields: { "__type": "localized-value-descriptor", "enable": true, "tag": "hint", "localizedString": { "en-US": "text" } }

name.description: Page title shown in the editor (required, max 80 chars)

path.description: Page route, lowercase only — letters (a-z), digits (0-9), hyphen and slash, no trailing slash (e.g. "/news"). "/" is reserved for the main page (required).

type.description: Seed the page from a site-template key (SiteTemplate.key). Choose this OR "createFromSite", not both. Call "list_site_templates" to discover valid keys; the server rejects unknown ones. Omit both to fall back to the default game-sales page.

parsingUrl.description: Sub-option of "type": storefront URL to seed content from. Requires "type", and only valid when that SiteTemplate has a truthy "parsingSupport" field (see "list_site_templates"; e.g. "sellingpage" → Steam/Epic, "topup"). Omit otherwise.

createFromSite.description: Seed the page by cloning an existing site instead of a template. Choose this OR "type", not both. Source site _id (MongoId); copies that site's main page ('/') and its blocks.

domain.description: Site Domain — the site identifier/slug (e.g. "sb-xxxx-site"), not a network hostname (required)

blockValues.description: Optional override for sidebar values. Structure: { values: { title, developer, logo, socials, ... } }. Localized fields use LocalizedValueDescriptor format.

merchantId.description: Merchant ID (required). Must be provided by the user — do not infer or reuse.

projectId.description: Project ID (required). Must be provided by the user — do not infer or reuse.

domain.description: Site Domain — the new site identifier/slug (e.g. "sb-xxxx-site"), not a network hostname (required). Must be provided by the user — do not auto-generate.

type.description: topup (mobile top-up webshop), sellingpage (single PC/Steam game landing), or store (multi-game storefront). Infer from product; ask only if ambiguous.

target.description: Storefront URL to seed content. STRICT: topup → apps.apple.com / play.google.com only; sellingpage → store.steampowered.com only; omit for store. Mismatch → switch type or clarify, do not pass through.

emptyBlock.description: Do NOT ask. true only if user signals custom initial layout (start blank / design own blocks); else false to keep template blocks.

GLOBALS — DO NOT import, they are injected automatically (importing causes "symbol already declared"): useControls, text, color, toggle, number, select, localizedText, AutoControls. MUST IMPORT explicitly (NOT globals): import { TextEditor } from '@site-builder/block-utils'; — required for every canvas text field; missing this import = ReferenceError at runtime. name.description: Stable identifier for the text field (e.g. "title", "cta")

default.description: Default text value for this field

domain.description: Site Domain — the site identifier/slug (e.g. "sb-xxxx-site"), not a network hostname (required)

values.description:
Partial block values to update. Keys are relative to block.values — do NOT include a leading "values." prefix (unlike create_block which wraps everything in { values: {...} }). Examples: "title" patches block.values.title; "internalBlockValues.chainSettings.stepsLayout" patches that nested field. Keys support dot notation. Unspecified keys remain unchanged. Localized fields use LocalizedValueDescriptor format. LOCALIZED FIELDS — REPLACE, NOT MERGE: a localized field is patched as a whole object. The localizedString you pass REPLACES the entire existing one, so any locale you omit is LOST. To change one locale, you MUST include ALL existing locales (call get_block first to read them) and edit only the target — e.g. to translate the title to Russian, send localizedString with every current locale plus the new "ru-RU", not just { "ru-RU": "..." }. Pass PLAIN text per locale; the server re-wraps it using quillWrapper (do not include existing

/

tags or you get double-wrapping).

components.description: Full components array replacement (e.g. gallery slides). Replaces all existing components.

domain.description: Site Domain — the site identifier/slug (e.g. "sb-xxxx-site"), not a network hostname (required)

enableLazyLoadStoreBlock.description: "Lazy Load Store" — defer loading of the store block.

hideGdprConsent.description: "Hide GDPR Consent" — suppress the GDPR consent banner.

enablePurchaseButtonWhenItemInCart.description: "Enable Purchase Button When Item in Cart" — keep the buy button active for items already in the cart.

disableOptimisticStorePreload.description: "Disable Optimistic Store Preload" — turn off optimistic preloading of store data.

enableSpaCustomCode.description: "Enable SPA custom code" — run custom code under SPA navigation.

disableUnclaimedIndicator.description: "Disable Unclaimed Indicator for Unauthenticated Items" — hide the unclaimed badge for unauthenticated users.

isIndependentWindowsForIosMobile.description: "Is Independent Windows For IOS Mobile" — open independent windows on iOS mobile.

enableExpandedIosLandscapeSafeArea.description: "Enable Expanded iOS Landscape Safe Area" — expand the safe area in iOS landscape.

disableSendSteamIdToStore.description: "Disable Send Steam ID to Store API" — stop forwarding the Steam ID to the Store API.

hideBuyButtonSelector.description: "Hide Buy Button selector in all Store sections" — true hides it (stored as hideBuyButtonSelectorGlobalState="on"), false shows it ("off").

showRewardsBalanceInHeader.description: "Show reward balance in header" — toggle the rewards balance display in the header.

showZeroRewardsBalance.description: Show the rewards balance even when it is zero. Only meaningful alongside showRewardsBalanceInHeader; the existing value is preserved if omitted.

storePreloadLimit.description: "Limit store preload requests" — number of preload requests (0-10). Pass null to remove the limit (toggle off).

domain.description: Site Domain — the site identifier/slug (e.g. "sb-xxxx-site"), not a network hostname (required)

localizationId.description: Localization DB key including "L:" prefix (e.g. "L:178e740e-c0d0-4133-90a2-f4ccbf18718c"). For federated blocks: use the localizationId field returned by get_block_translations (NOT the short resourceKey).

pageId.description: Page _id for page-scoped localization. Omit for common (site-level) localization.

domain.description: Site Domain — the site identifier/slug (e.g. "sb-xxxx-site"), not a network hostname (required)

path.description: New page route, lowercase only (a-z, 0-9, hyphen, slash), no trailing slash. If another page already owns this path, the two pages swap paths (used for reordering).

draft.description: Publish state: true keeps the page as a draft, false publishes it.

type.description: Reinitialize the page from a site-template key (see "list_site_templates"). Only allowed when the page is currently of type "empty"; the server rejects re-initializing a non-empty page or passing "empty" here.

parsingUrl.description: Storefront URL to seed content from when reinitializing via "type". Only valid for templates with parsingSupport.

theme.description: Per-page theme override (colors, fonts, radius, blur). Setting it enables the page-level theme; omitted fields inherit the current page theme, or the site theme if the page has none. To restyle ALL pages instead, use "update_theme".

primary.description: Primary accent/brand color — buttons, links, highlights

domain.description: Site Domain — the site identifier/slug (e.g. "sb-xxxx-site"), not a network hostname (required)

locale.description: Locale for the localized text fields (title, description, ogImage), e.g. "en-US", "ru-RU". Defaults to "en-US". One call writes ONE locale — call again per locale to translate.

title.description: SEO / OpenGraph title for the given locale — the <title>, og:title and Google result heading. Updates the text for that locale only.

description.description: SEO / OpenGraph meta description for the given locale — the meta description and og:description. Updates the text for that locale only.

ogImage.description: OpenGraph share image URL (og:image) for the given locale. Recommended 1200x630. Must be an absolute URL.

indexable.description: Search-engine indexing. true = indexable; false emits <meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow"> so the page is hidden from search engines.

canonicalUrl.description: Canonical URL for the page (<link rel="canonical">). Absolute URL, or an empty string ("") to clear it.

customHeadHTML.description: Raw HTML injected into <head> (extra meta tags, verification snippets, structured data). Replaces the existing value entirely; pass "" to clear.

manifestEnable.description: Enable the PWA web manifest for this page.

manifestIcon192.description: PWA manifest icon URL, 192x192. Absolute URL.

manifestIcon512.description: PWA manifest icon URL, 512x512. Absolute URL.

domain.description: Site Domain — the site identifier/slug (e.g. "sb-xxxx-site"), not a network hostname (required)

favicon.description: Favicon URL for the whole site (<link rel="icon">). Site-level, applies to every page. Absolute URL (required).

domain.description: Site Domain — the site identifier/slug (e.g. "sb-xxxx-site"), not a network hostname (required)

primary.description: Primary accent/brand color — buttons, links, highlights

theme.description: Site-wide theme changes. Applies to every page that has not set its own per-page override. Provide at least one field.

componentCode.description: componentCode to validate before calling create_ai_block or update_ai_block

textFields.description: textFields array — used to verify every localizedText() call has a matching declaration

name.description: Stable identifier for the text field (e.g. "title", "cta")

default.description: Default text value for this field
